attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a NAT gateway on a new private LAN (10.50.50.0/24 via eth1): node1=10.50.50.254 as gateway, node2=10.50.50.11, node3=10.50.50.12, with a VyOS source-NAT masquerade rule translating 10.50.50.0/24 out eth0. node2 and node3 got static eth1 addresses and a lower-metric default route via node1, persisted in /etc/network/interfaces via post-up/pre-down ip route hooks. Verified with ping/curl and conntrack showing translated flows (src=10.50.50.x -> dst=10.100.144.10 on the reply side). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (node1 first as router, then node2, then node3), each showing a changed OS boot_id and full functional recovery (NAT config/persistence on node1, internet reachability via node1 on node2/node3) after restart.
